independent_review.scope: Policy/input boundaries plus lifecycle and existing-database admission
Artifact recovery, restart execution and benchmark receipt/limit boundaries
Real CLI/config/SQLite integration and CLI routing; no mocking of admission service

verified_boundaries: Only global FAILED / training COMPLETE / evaluation FAILED with matching legacy status and history can open a retry. Ordinary FAILED-to-QUEUED training reset remains unchanged.

Duplicate pending requests do not write state/history, archive again, launch work or spend benchmark looks. They must still match the policy and training/checkpoint evidence pinned by the original request.

Filesystem preparation is an allowlisted, recoverable manifest under _evaluation_retries/<failed transition ID>; old outputs and receipts remain recoverable, and generation metrics, training configuration, lineage and checkpoint files are never moved.
Partial rename, copy or SQL failure can be re-admitted through the same manifest; conflicting source/destination bytes fail closed without overwrite.
Existing-database CLI open does not create a missing database or bootstrap/migrate an incompatible one. Retry subcommand runs before provider/license/GPU setup.
After clearing in-memory pending and reopening the database, the actual scheduler dispatches evaluation only, with a new attempt receipt; fake process and GPU boundaries are explicit.

Old benchmark provenance remains pinned at the original path and is copied into the archive. New preparation consumes the next bounded look and requires a new nonce; missing ledger, stale receipt, exhausted budget or silent provenance publication cannot launch evaluation.
compatibility: See docs/evaluation-retry.md. G1 and all earlier tests remain unchanged.
A metrics.json in-place evaluator alias is not archived. This preserves legacy invocation without claiming immutable generation storage.
limits: No actual GPU, evaluator subprocess, paid LLM/provider, production license activation, deployment, package publication or live campaign mutation. Temporary files and SQLite are real; external execution is doubled.
This is recoverable file preparation plus a transactional lifecycle change, not one atomic filesystem/SQLite transaction or distributed exactly-once delivery.
No stale-attempt ABA fence or universal process liveness authority. Known unclosed local evaluation receipts block admission; legacy failures without start receipts rely on the agreed lifecycle.
Pending retry scan is bounded to 128 entries. Fairness/pagination/backpressure under persistently blocked entries remain V1-03 work.

Admission spends no benchmark look, but existing evaluation preparation precedes the GPU lease/process launch. A later preflight/lease/publication failure can consume a reserved look, and some preflight failures remain pending. No reservation-ordering or automatic backoff fix is claimed.

Explicit policy, environment, interpreter and selected generation/checkpoint inputs are pinned; ambient dependencies or unsealed evaluator source bytes are not a complete immutable execution environment. Hashing large checkpoints can hold the admission database write lock.
Manifest copies of provenance are historical; current provenance may legitimately advance after reservation. No scientific independence or research-efficiency gain follows from test counts.
V1-01 remaining consumers and progress semantics, V1-02 recovery/fencing, and the full V1-03 through V1-07 phases remain unaccepted.
